title: 🔥周期指标回归历史大底
body: 市场处于深度筑底阶段。AHR999 (3D版) 为 0.32，处于抄底区。该数值持平于历史数据中 2022-12 的月均值 0.32，意味着当前周期位置回归至与上一轮熊市末期相同的极低水位，定投性价比极高。偏多。变盘节点何时出现？
body_en: Market is deep in the accumulation phase. The AHR999 (3D) sits at 0.32—firmly in the buy zone. This metric mirrors the monthly average from Dec 2022, signaling that we’ve returned to the same extreme lows seen at the end of the last bear market. The risk/reward for DCAing here is exceptional. Bullish bias. But when will the reversal trigger?
